message.reasoning: We have total 250 boxes. Let x = first house. second house = 2x? Wait: "المنزل الأول يحتاج إلى نصف المنزل الثاني" meaning first needs half of second. So x = (1/2)*second => second = 2x. Third needs double first: third = 2x. Total: x + 2x + 2x = 5x = 250 => x=50. Third = 2x = 100.
